title: Bug: Queue.pop() returns the newest item instead of the oldest (FIFO violated) and peek() on empty raises
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/queue_manager.py`

`TaskQueue.pop()` removes the LAST item (LIFO) although the class is documented as FIFO. `peek()` on an empty queue raises IndexError instead of returning None.
### Expected
- pop() returns items in insertion order
- peek()/pop() on empty return None (pop with default)
